oliver (Eng Manager): Quick question — considering a mid-cycle promo L3->L4 for Priya effective 2026-10-01. We want a 10% base increase + small one-time RSU. Is comp committee required?

jess (People Ops): Congrats! If the base increase is <=10% and remains inside the L4 band, no comp committee. Equity requires Equity Grant Request.

marta (Compensation): Add: if total comp (base+equity run-rate) pushes above band midpoint or base >10%, committee needed. Include manager justification + updated scorecard.

oliver (Eng Manager): Payroll timing — if we submit now can it hit Oct payroll?

payroll-bot: Payroll cutoff for October effective changes is 2026-09-15 17:00 PDT. Approvals after cutoff apply to November payroll. See https://intra.redwood/payroll

andrew (Finance): From finance: include GL code and effective date in the request. Backpay needs separate approval and cost forecast if requested.

jess (People Ops): Quick tip for justification: 1-sentence recommendation + 3 bullets of impact (metrics, scope, mentorship). That speeds committee review if needed.

oliver (Eng Manager): Thanks — I'll draft the packet and tag @marta for pre-review before submission.
